hooks.statusMessage: gofmt + go vet + go test on changed package
hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.go) gofmt -w "$f"; d=$(dirname "$f"); m="$d"; while [ "$m" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$m/go.mod" ]; do m=$(dirname "$m"); done; [ -f "$m/go.mod" ] || exit 0; rel=${d#"$m"/}; [ "$rel" = "$d" ] && rel="."; cd "$m" && go vet "./$rel" && go test "./$rel";; esac; } 2>&1 || true
